checkpoint.title: New game to the station platform

events.why: from HOME (the game closed, no save) launch the selected tile, then the language list, the look picker and the name keyboard with the panel's choices; on Confirm Choices already, nothing

Confirm Choices shows (so the save is fresh): check that screen with no press (anything else is a setup error) and that it shows the panel's name and language, then DOWN to Ready!, reading the highlight after each, and A
the opening cutscene, no presses (A does not advance it), until the autosave badge has shown and the station platform holds

metadata.source: played step by step from a new game
